cover.title:
agent 想停下时先压缩上下文
2,000 轮覆盖率翻了一倍多
cover.dek: MiMo 在 2,000 轮里的能力覆盖，原策略只有 32.4%，SCoRe 在 agent 想停下时压缩上下文后到了 67.0%。另一篇论文测出，有缓存折扣时删旧观察反而更贵。
cover.title_en:
Compress context when the agent
wants to stop, and coverage doubles
cover.dek_en: On MiMo, the original policy covered 32.4% of capabilities over 2,000 turns. SCoRe, which compresses context at the moment an agent wants to stop, reaches 67.0%. A second paper finds that dropping old observations can raise costs when prefix caching is discounted.

stickers.title: 论文角
stickers.text: 有前缀缓存折扣时，删掉旧观察可能让成本上升 38–116%。
stickers.text_en: With a prefix-cache discount, deleting old observations can raise cost by 38–116%.
